Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer states that "Walt Mossberg was 63 years old when he reviewed the first iPad in April 2010," while the Ground Truth Answer states, "Walt Mossberg was 63 when the first iPad was released." Both answers provide the journalist’s age (63) at the relevant time (the release/review time of the first iPad, which aligns with April 2010). The substance and vital fact—the journalist’s age at the time of the first iPad's release—are clearly present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: TRUE
